A created subject now has an empty before side, and the page says the patch creates the file. An unchanged subject is taken when the patch changes exactly one Java file of its source tree whose class the subject's source names; the excerpts show that file and the page says so, while the verified unit, the claim's file and the SARIF location stay the subject's. Anything else is refused as before.

Reproducers in test_build.py's ExcerptsTest, on the five examples' own patches and made-up ones: 5 errors before the fix, all pass after. The rest of test_build.py passes except ReplayWordingTest on example 171's page, which fails at the parent commit too and is recorded under the brief's Progress, with the 148/149 jobs' expectation of '1 proved, 2 tested' that the current tool can no longer give.
